parameters.content:
## 📥 Collecte des offres
Toutes les 4 h (8h → 20h), ce workflow :
1. interroge l'**API France Travail** pour chaque recherche active (table `searches`)
2. lit les **flux RSS** d'offres (table `feeds`)
3. normalise et dédoublonne les offres, puis les enregistre dans **PostgreSQL**
4. déclenche l'**analyse IA** des nouvelles offres

💡 Ajoute des recherches depuis Telegram : `/recherche_ajouter mots-clés | département | contrat`

parameters.query:
SELECT id, label, keywords, department, contract_type
FROM searches
WHERE active
ORDER BY id;

parameters.jsonQuery: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries({ motsCles: $json.keywords, departement: $json.department, typeContrat: $json.contract_type, publieeDepuis: 3, range: "0-49", sort: 1 }).filter(([k, v]) => v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== ""))) }}

parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, url
FROM feeds
WHERE active
ORDER BY id;

WITH data AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
    source text, external_id text, url text, title text, company text, location text,
    contract_type text, salary text, description text, published_at timestamptz,
    search_id int, feed_id int)
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO jobs (source, external_id, url, title, company, location, contract_type,
                    salary, description, published_at, search_id, feed_id)
  SELECT source, external_id, url, title, company, location, contract_type,
         salary, description, published_at, search_id, feed_id
  FROM data
  ON CONFLICT (source, external_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), search_stats AS (
  UPDATE searches s SET last_run_at = now(), last_count = x.cnt
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS x(id int, cnt int)
  WHERE s.id = x.id
  RETURNING 1
), feed_stats AS (
  UPDATE feeds f SET
    last_fetched_at = now(),
    last_count      = x.cnt,
    error_count     = CASE WHEN x.ok THEN 0 ELSE f.error_count + 1 END,
    last_error      = x.error,
    active          = CASE WHEN x.ok THEN true ELSE f.error_count + 1 < 10 END
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS x(id int, ok boolean, error text, cnt int)
  WHERE f.id = x.id
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT $4::text AS origin,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM data)::int     AS collected,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted)::int AS inserted,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM search_stats)::int + (SELECT count(*) FROM feed_stats)::int AS sources;
